purpose: Natural-language regression cases for continuity, pivot discipline, creative freedom and resistance to over-control. Criteria describe outcomes, not skill vocabulary.

cases.prompt: No mobile o headline quebra mal e o CTA ficou apertado. Corrija.
cases.setup: The page is otherwise strong, specific and coherent across desktop and mobile.
must: Fix the mobile defect and recheck the affected viewport.
Keep the valid proposition and visual idea intact unless the fix reveals a broader problem.
must_not: Use a local mobile defect as a reason to redesign the whole page.

cases.prompt: O hero está bonito, mas parece um produto de vigilância e não uma ferramenta de coordenação.
cases.setup: The rendered page consistently creates the wrong category meaning even though typography, spacing and motion are polished.
must: Change the governing idea rather than merely polishing the same metaphor.
Keep still-valid product facts, audience understanding and conversion goal.
Explore a materially different way to express coordination.
must_not: Try to solve the category misread only with colors, spacing or microcopy.
Restart research that remains valid without a reason.

cases.prompt: A página ficou repetitiva no meio.
cases.setup: The hero is distinctive, but three later regions repeat the same card geometry and reading rhythm.
must: Change the narrative/compositional treatment of the weak regions.
Keep the page's strong central idea while varying the medium according to each message.
must_not: Abandon the whole creative idea solely because later sections are generic.
Mask repetition with more decoration.

cases.prompt: Mudança importante: essa campanha agora deve levar para demo enterprise, não trial self-service.
cases.setup: The current page was designed around low-friction self-serve conversion.
must: Reconsider CTA, friction, proof and proposition consequences rather than only renaming the button.
Preserve factual product truth and reuse solved design work that still serves the new sales motion.
must_not: Treat the change as copy-only.
Throw away every existing design decision reflexively.

cases.prompt: Descobrimos que essa integração ainda não existe.
cases.setup: The integration appears in the hero and is used as an important proof point later in the page.
must: Remove the unsupported implication everywhere it matters.
Reconsider any promise or proof strategy that depended on the integration.
Keep unaffected evidence and design decisions.
must_not: Leave the integration implied because removing it weakens the current design.
Invent a roadmap commitment.

cases.prompt: Durante a implementação surgiu uma ideia muito melhor: usar o próprio histórico de decisões do produto como a narrativa central.
cases.setup: The current direction is coherent and partly implemented. The new idea uses stronger real product evidence and appears substantially more specific.
must: Compare the new idea on meaning, specificity and evidence use rather than sunk implementation effort.
Switch direction if the new idea is materially stronger.
Keep compatible solved work instead of restarting from zero.
must_not: Reject the idea solely because implementation has begun.
Add it as a second competing signature without choosing.

cases.prompt: E se a gente fizer tudo em 3D? Parece mais premiável.
cases.setup: The current page already has a specific, effective creative idea. No communication problem requires 3D.
must: Keep the strong existing direction unless 3D improves a real experience job.
Treat 3D as an experiment, not as automatic premium quality.
must_not: Replace a resolved concept merely because a more technically elaborate option exists.

cases.prompt: Está bonito, mas parece que poderia ser de qualquer SaaS.
cases.setup: Craft is high, but the main idea and page structure survive a logo/copy swap with unrelated products.
must: Return to product/domain evidence and find a more specific governing idea when the genericity is conceptual.
Keep truthful proposition and proof that still work.
must_not: Add gradients, noise, illustrations or animation merely to disguise a generic concept.

cases.prompt: Fazendo o protótipo percebi que o recurso mais forte não é organizar notas; é mostrar de onde cada decisão veio e quem participou.
cases.setup: The original proposition emphasized organization. The product repository and demo do support provenance and collaborative decision history, but this framing was not prominent in the initial brief.
must: Treat the new framing as a serious proposition hypothesis and verify it against available product evidence.
Allow the page strategy to change if the new framing is both truthful and materially stronger.
Rework downstream narrative/design only to the extent required by the stronger proposition.
must_not: Reject the insight merely because strategy was synthesized earlier.
Promote the idea to a factual market claim without evidence.

cases.prompt: Cada seção está precisando de um truque diferente para a ideia continuar funcionando.
cases.setup: Several local fixes have accumulated; each is individually plausible, but the page is becoming brittle and visually inconsistent.
must: Question whether the shared visual/compositional system or governing idea is the actual source of the repeated failures.
Simplify at the highest necessary level rather than adding more patches.
must_not: Continue accumulating unrelated local exceptions indefinitely.

cases.prompt: Crie a landing de lançamento para uma marca de moda experimental. Quero algo autoral, não com cara de SaaS.
cases.setup: The collection has strong editorial photography, irregular garment construction and a single purchase/drop CTA. Product truth is clear.
must: Allow a fashion-appropriate visual world, unusual composition and pacing when they serve the launch.
Keep the conversion path legible without forcing software conventions onto the page.
must_not: Default to dashboard imagery, rounded-card grids, forensic-instrument aesthetics or another recurring house style.

cases.setup: The rendered page is already specific, coherent, accessible and materially resolved. No new evidence or concrete defect is supplied.
must: Diagnose whether any meaningful improvement remains before changing the concept.
Prefer higher resolution of existing intent over gratuitous novelty.
must_not: Redesign solely to demonstrate creativity.
Add fashionable effects without causal value.

cases.prompt: A assinatura principal não cabe no mobile.
cases.setup: The desktop signature is a large spatial comparison whose purpose is to make transformation instantly understandable; its geometry cannot survive small screens.
must: Create a different mobile expression that preserves the signature's communication job.
Change sequence, crop or interaction rather than shrinking the desktop scene mechanically.
must_not: Require the same form across viewports.
Drop the signature and leave mobile as an inferior edition without testing alternatives.

cases.prompt: O código segue o plano, então acho que terminou.
cases.setup: The browser render has weak hierarchy and the intended signature is barely perceptible even though the source matches the design plan.
must: Treat the rendered result as stronger evidence than plan fidelity.
Continue improving the page until the material perceptual defect is resolved or a real blocker exists.
must_not: Declare completion because the implementation matches written intent.
